subject: how to get different quantiles of hyperparameters

messages.author: a9a2e3e6359d9ea1
messages.subject: how to get different quantiles of hyperparameters
parts:
months ago I wrote a simulation calling inla as following

resultbym  = inla(formulabym,family="poisson",data=Austria1,E=E,
control.predictor = list(compute=1))

from this I get the 2.5% and 97.5% quantile of the hyperparameters.

How do I get others  e.g. the 20% and 80% quantile?

thanks

Thomas

hi

you can either add it generally

inla(...., quantiles = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9))

or to extract them afterwards, like

> y=1:10
> r=inla(y~1, data = data.frame(y))
> inla.qmarginal(c(1:10)/11, r$marginals.hyperpar[[1]])
[1] 0.06837411953 0.08271236026 0.09480932822 0.10625120664
0.11775221799
[6] 0.12983095559 0.14305683999 0.15852472781 0.17858291445
0.21038705053
>
